subject: Cloud PO listing hold, trailing commission & channel passback — CloudNova
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudnova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudnova.com
Date: 2027-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify listing hold + trailing commission for Azure private offer

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for sending the draft PO earlier. Procurement reviewed the line items and we have two open asks before we can proceed to legal:

1) Listing hold / escrow: how long does Redwood expect the listing escrow to remain in place after go-live? We want to align accounting and marketplace listing timelines.

2) Trailing commission to our distribution partner: the draft notes a trailing percentage but not the exact schedule. Can you confirm month-by-month payback and whether it is calculated on net or gross list price?

I've attached our procurement checklist for reference (cloudnova_po_requirements.pdf).

If you can send a concrete proposal (numbers + invoice flow), we can share with our reseller to confirm passback compatibility.

Appreciate the quick turnaround—we are targeting signature the week of Aug 24.

Best,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Procurement
CloudNova Systems

[attachment: cloudnova_po_requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify listing hold + trailing commission for Azure private offer

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the checklist and the clear asks. Proposed structure below (aiming to reduce back-and-forth):

Listing hold / escrow
- Proposed hold: 60 days after the private offer is published in the Azure Marketplace (listing escrow held by Redwood). This gives both accounting and marketplace time to reconcile onboarding adjustments.
- Escrow release: after 60 days assuming no disputed usage or chargebacks. If usage disputes arise, escrow will be held until resolved (standard dispute T+30).

Trailing commission (to distributor/reseller)
- Total trailing window: 6 months from invoice date.
- Payout cadence: monthly.
- Calculation basis: net invoice value (after discounts/refunds).
- Proposed trailing percent: 10% of net revenue for months 1–3, then 5% for months 4–6 (waterfall). Example breakdown attached.

Invoice & passback flow
- Redwood invoices CloudNova. Redwood issues partner commission to the reseller via credit note within 30 days of invoice receipt.
- Distributor passback shown as a separate line item on the invoice so CloudNova's AP can route it to the reseller without impacting gross recognition.

Attachments: commission_waterfall.xlsx (example schedule + sample math) and a sample PO draft (cloudnova_po_draft_20270818.pdf).

Next steps
- Ben / Naomi: could you confirm the tax handling and whether the 10%/5% split needs country-specific adjustments?
- Sanjay: if you can confirm that structure with your reseller (particularly that monthly passback line is acceptable), I'll ask legal to generate a DocuSign-ready PO.

Happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Lead, Cloud & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[attachments: commission_waterfall.xlsx (spreadsheet); cloudnova_po_draft_20270818.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify listing hold + trailing commission for Azure private offer

On Wed, Aug 18, 2027 at 11:01 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> (proposed structure)

Thanks Marcus — clear and pragmatic. A couple internal notes:

- Trailing %: 10%/5% waterfall seems reasonable but we should cap total commission exposure per account to avoid tail risk (suggest cap = $50k per year for this deal).
- Escrow term: 60 days OK, prefer to avoid 90-day holds; shorter escrow reduces reconciliation overhead for marketplace operations.
- Tax: Naomi, please confirm if the partner credit should be treated as contra-revenue or a reseller rebate in our books (this drives invoice wording).

Irene: can Legal confirm whether the proposed invoice line item meets marketplace listing requirements (explicit passback line, tax handling) so we don't get blocked by Azure listing validation?

If all good, Marcus — proceed to have Legal/Contracts prepare the PO for DocuSign with the cap and explicit passback line item.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Channel Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudnova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudnova.com, resellers@partnerco.com
Date: 2027-08-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify listing hold + trailing commission for Azure private offer

Marcus / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the sample waterfall. A couple things from the reseller side:

- Distributor passback: our reseller asked if the initial month could be 12% (they take more of the upfront onboarding costs) and then the 10%/5% waterfall as you proposed. They said 8% is too low for month 1.
- Cap: CloudNova is fine with a cap in principle; can you share the proposed dollar cap math so we can confirm with finance?
- DocuSign & timeline: procurement is still targeting signature by Aug 24 — if you can generate the DocuSign by EOD Aug 20 we can route it through our approval queue.

We can accept the 60-day escrow if the DocuSign references the specific release conditions and the invoice passback line.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Procurement
CloudNova Systems

[attachment: reseller_passback_request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify listing hold + trailing commission for Azure private offer

Sanjay — thanks, we can accommodate the reseller request with a small adjustment. Agreed terms below: 

Confirmed terms (final)
- Listing escrow: 60 days post-publish, released after reconciliation or dispute resolution (T+30 when disputed).
- Trailing commission: month 1 = 12% (reseller onboarding uplift), months 2–4 = 10% each, months 5–6 = 5% each.
- Cap: maximum commission exposure = $45,000 per 12-month period for this PO (we ran the math against your volume forecast).
- Calculation: based on net invoice value (post-discounts/refunds).
- Invoice flow: Redwood issues invoice to CloudNova; reseller credit issued as a separate credit memo line within 30 days; passback line explicitly referenced for AP routing.

Action items
- Marcus: I'll ask Legal to prepare the PO with the above and the explicit escrow release language and send DocuSign link by EOD Aug 20.
- Naomi: confirm tax treatment (contra-revenue vs rebate) and update invoice wording if needed.
- Sanjay: once DocuSign is live please route to procurement and the reseller; we'll stand by to do a short call if any questions.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/seed/abc123-cloudnova-po
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/DN-78321

Thanks everyone — aiming to close this week.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Lead, Cloud & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
